effects.description: What else the real call would change, each with a count; a kind with nothing to change is listed with a count of 0.

atLeast.description: Present when `count` is a floor: more exist than one answer can count.

count.description: How many of them the call would change.

kind.description: What is counted: the kind of thing the call would change besides its target.

target.description: What the real call would act on.

granteeOwnerId.description: The current workspace member owner identifier.

currentBuildId.description: The build that takes the new unpinned work the ramp does not.

deploymentName.description: The deployment the routing belongs to.

generation.description: Increases by one on every write; pass it back as `expectedGeneration`.

previousBuildId.description: The build that was current before the latest change of `currentBuildId`, which `bureau.deployments.rollback` returns to; `null` until the current build has changed once.

rampBasisPoints.description: The ramping build’s share of new unpinned work, from 0 to 10000.

rampingBuildId.description: The build taking `rampBasisPoints` of new unpinned work, or `null` when none ramps.

updatedAt.description: When the routing was last written, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

deploymentName.description: The name of the worker deployment whose routing is read or moved.

expectedGeneration.description: Apply the move only if the routing is still at this `generation`, for example the one `bureau.deployments.get` returned; a routing that has moved past it is a `Conflict` (`reason: "stale-generation"`). Omitted, the move is fenced by the generation it reads itself.

action.description: What the hook does for each event. A hook stored before actions existed is a `webhook`.

ownerDisabled.description: The owner turned the hook off; a reconcile keeps it off.

plugin.description: The plugin that declared the hook.

withdrawn.description: The plugin no longer declares the hook, so it is off and the owner cannot turn it on.

declaredBy.description: Where a default hook comes from: the plugin that declared it (COR-2179). The owner can turn it on or off and copy it, and changes nothing else about it. `null` for a hook the owner made.

events.description: The event kinds the hook fires on: a published Bureau kind as it is, and a kind a plugin declares pinned to the version it was written at, `<plugin>:<name>@<version>`.

owner.description: The principal that owns the hook.

scope.description: The one subject the hook fires for; `null` for a hook that fires for the whole Bureau. `kind` is `agent`, `workflow` or `schedule`. A stored kind this release does not know is shown as stored, and a stored value it cannot read is shown with an empty `kind`; neither fires.

anyOf.description: The signing secret the Bureau generated, `whsec_` and 24 hexadecimal digits. This is the only answer that carries it: no operation returns it again, so keep it now, or replace it later with `bureau.hooks.secret.replace`.

signingSecret.description: The signing secret the Bureau generated for a webhook created without one, shown this once; `null` when the caller chose the secret or the action has none.

id.description: What a plugin’s reaction made in the other service, as it named it.

summary.description: What was made, at most 200 characters; a longer one is dropped.

url.description: Where to see it: an `https:` address; a reaction’s other value is dropped.

receipt.description: What a `completed` attempt made: the run, the notification, or a plugin reaction’s receipt.

nextAttemptAt.description: Epoch milliseconds the next attempt is due, while a `pending` delivery waits out its backoff after a failed attempt; `null` otherwise.

request.description: The request of a `webhook` delivery; `null` for the other actions.

configuration.description: The configuration of a `plugin` delivery; `null` otherwise.

input.description: A `start-workflow` delivery’s workflow input; a `plugin` delivery’s event, `{ kind, bureauId, emittedAtMs, payload, source? }`.

plugin.description: The plugin of a `plugin` delivery; `null` otherwise.

pluginKind.description: The action kind of a `plugin` delivery; `null` otherwise.

skip.description: Why a `start-workflow` delivery starts nothing: the event is about a run a hook started, or cannot be placed. `null` otherwise.

work.description: What a `start-workflow`, `notify` or `plugin` delivery does, mapped from the event when it was created; `null` for a webhook.

action.description: What the hook does for each event. A hook stored before actions existed is a `webhook`.

ownerDisabled.description: The owner turned the hook off; a reconcile keeps it off.

plugin.description: The plugin that declared the hook.

withdrawn.description: The plugin no longer declares the hook, so it is off and the owner cannot turn it on.

declaredBy.description: Where a default hook comes from: the plugin that declared it (COR-2179). The owner can turn it on or off and copy it, and changes nothing else about it. `null` for a hook the owner made.

events.description: The event kinds the hook fires on: a published Bureau kind as it is, and a kind a plugin declares pinned to the version it was written at, `<plugin>:<name>@<version>`.

owner.description: The principal that owns the hook.

scope.description: The one subject the hook fires for; `null` for a hook that fires for the whole Bureau. `kind` is `agent`, `workflow` or `schedule`. A stored kind this release does not know is shown as stored, and a stored value it cannot read is shown with an empty `kind`; neither fires.

agentId.description: The identifier of the agent whose memory this addresses.
The identifier of the agent whose memory this addresses.

granteeOwnerId.description: The owner who may read this memory: another agent’s collection owner or, later, a user. Not the caller’s own owner.

all.description: `true` changes every notification the caller has that is not already changed.

ids.description: These notifications, from 1 to 100 identifiers. An unknown identifier is skipped.

expectedRevision.description: The schedule’s `revision` the caller read; when it has changed since, the call is a `StaleRevision` fault and nothing is written.

runId.description: The identifier of the failed agent run: its task id.

expectedHash.description: The `hash` of the workflow file the caller read; a file that has changed since is a `StaleRevision` fault and nothing is written.

data.description: Audited fault-specific context; omitted when no fields are safe to expose

remediation.description: One line of plain text saying what to do next; omitted when none is known

retryable.description: Whether repeating the identical call later can succeed; present on every operation fault

weftCode.description: Fine-grained public Weft error code when one is available
